description: This file defines an interface class 'ISessionServerAppManager' for managing session server applications within the Rialto server manager component. It declares virtual methods for application lifecycle management, state changes, ping events, and log level configuration.

classes.name: ISessionServerAppManager
classes.description: An interface class providing virtual methods for session server application management, including initialization, state management, ping handling, and logging configuration.

methods.name: preloadSessionServers
methods.description: Preloads a specified number of session servers.

methods.name: initiateApplication
methods.description: Initiates a session server application with a given name, state, and configuration.

methods.name: setSessionServerState
methods.description: Sets the state of a session server application identified by its name.

methods.name: onSessionServerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when a session server's state has changed.

methods.name: sendPingEvents
methods.description: Sends ping events with a specified ping ID.

methods.name: onAck
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment responses for ping events.

methods.name: getAppConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection information for a specified application.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for the service.
